TextLint Tool version 0.1.0-beta.1+eb4e3950a39ba10ad14e05283d1a6f1c79d7659b
Copyright (c) DEMA Consulting

Usage: textlint [options] [globs...]

Options:
  -v, --version              Display version information
  -?, -h, --help             Display this help message
  --silent                   Suppress console output (a command line that cannot be understood
                             is still reported on standard error)
  --validate                 Run self-validation
  --results <file>           Write validation results to file (.trx or .xml)
  --depth <#>                Set heading depth for markdown output (default: 1)
  --log <file>               Write output to log file
  --config <file>            Settings file (default: .textlint.yaml in the root directory, if present)
  --root <dir>               Directory that patterns and the default settings file are relative to
                             (default: current directory)
  --language <languages>     Language of the dictionaries, e.g. en-US or en-GB (overrides the settings)
  --allow-empty              Accept patterns that match no files (default: exit code 1)
  --max-parallelism <#>      Maximum number of files checked at the same time (default: processor count)

[globs...] are the files to check: paths or glob patterns, relative or absolute, replacing the
'files' setting; the 'ignorePaths' setting still applies. Quote globs so the shell does not
expand them.

Exit codes: 0 = no issues; 1 = issues found, a file could not be checked, no files matched, or an error
occurred.
